name: Elena Volkov
goals: Build a microservices migration roadmap and execution system
Create a platform engineering internal developer portal
Deploy AI-assisted code review and security scanning pipeline
communication_style: Strategic yet technical, discusses trade-offs, references AWS Well-Architected Framework, talks about developer experience and platform maturity
pain_points: Monolith is slowing down 12 engineering teams, deployments take 90 minutes
No internal developer portal, engineers waste 2 hours/day finding docs and runbooks
Security reviews are bottlenecked at one person, delaying every release
sample_prompts: Build an internal developer portal with service catalog, runbooks, deployment status, and on-call schedules for our 12 engineering teams
Create an AI-powered code review system that checks PRs for security vulnerabilities, performance anti-patterns, and style violations
Design a microservices decomposition tool that analyzes our monolith codebase and generates a migration dependency graph
